issue_context.title: Index records incomplete after adding index for a large table
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. Create a table with more than 1024 regions.
2. Add index for an arbitrary column.
3. Admin check table.

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

No data inconsistency.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
[admin:8223]data inconsistency in table
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

3cc368d45e

review_comments: Why here add this line to set worker size?
